post.description: Records one like per (comment, profile). IDEMPOTENT by construction (PK on comment_like): a repeat like is a no-op and emits no second event. Increments like_count in the same tx. Emits `comment.liked` (opaque profile_id only â€” R11). Likes NEVER reorder comments (no like-ranking; order stays chronological). Returns the updated like state. Malformed reference identifiers are rejected with 422 VALIDATION before persistence access.

get.summary: List comments on a Content (public read; flat top-level + one-level replies nested)
get.description: Returns visible top-level comments in CHRONOLOGICAL order (likes never reorder), each with its one-level reply thread nested in `replies` (max depth 1). Each comment/reply carries like_count and `liked` (whether the requesting traveler has liked it). `removed` comments are returned as tombstones (body cleared, status='removed') to preserve thread integrity; `hidden` comments are omitted from the traveler read. Pagination applies to TOP-LEVEL comments; replies are returned inline with their parent. PRD-0011 OQ-16 (security-reviewed APPROVE-WITH-CONDITIONS 2026-07-10): PUBLIC read with OPTIONAL auth. An anonymous request receives the thread with `liked=false` on every comment/reply; an authenticated request additionally resolves per-viewer `liked`. The moderation visibility projection is VIEWER-INDEPENDENT and identical on both paths â€” content-state based, not principal based: `hidden` is omitted and `removed` is returned as a tombstone (body cleared) for anonymous and authenticated readers alike (an anon reader never sees a hidden or un-tombstoned removed comment) (C16.1). The anonymous read is per-IP RATE-LIMITED (429 on breach, C16.2) and keeps the PerPage max-100 cap to bound bulk pulls. Writing/liking still requires auth: POST comment/reply and the like endpoints stay authenticated via the session cookie (cookieAuth + CSRF), unchanged. Malformed reference identifiers are rejected with 422 VALIDATION before persistence access.

post.summary: Create a comment, OR a one-level reply (parent_comment_id)
post.description: A signed-in Traveler posts a comment on the Content. If `parent_comment_id` is present it is a one-level REPLY (max depth 1): the use case REJECTS the reply with 422 `COMMENT_MAX_DEPTH` if the target parent itself has a parent (a reply cannot be replied to â€” D10). Body is UNTRUSTED plain text, stored as-is and HTML-escaped on render (NOT the WYSIWYG/sanitize path â€” OQ-19). Emits `comment.created` (a reply carries parent_comment_id) via the outbox in the same tx (ADR-0003). NO body text in the event (R11). Malformed reference identifiers are rejected with 422 VALIDATION before persistence access.

post.summary: Create a private itinerary
post.description: APPROVED PRD-0029 / accepted ADR-0061: one stable UUIDv7 Idempotency-Key per logical operation. Actor, operation, concrete target and normalized input are bound. Identical retries return the SAME result identity reconstructed under current authorization, not a stale response snapshot. Changed operation/target/input conflicts. Business mutation and operation receipt commit atomically. Unknown outcomes are recovered through the same POST and key, including after Redis/process loss. Deleted or inaccessible results return not_found without recreating. ADR-0062: reject keys older than 24 hours before execution or replay, even after receipt deletion. Receipts are retained at least 48 hours before background cleanup. Expiry never triggers automatic new-key retry. Existing success envelope and data shape remain unchanged.

Each marker is `{ id, kind, name, geo{lat,lng}, category_slug }` ONLY (PRD-0030 adds nullable category identity) â€” it NEVER carries reference_rating, ratings, why_it_matters, cultural_context, counts, or any Experience-Graph enrichment (M3, moat constraint). The `bbox` is validated (4 finite floats, min<max, WGS84 range, bounded area â€” a world-sized box is rejected 422). The set is server-capped at â‰¤500 markers/viewport; when the cap is hit `truncated` is true (the client should zoom in). get.summary: Public traveler profile by username (public read, optional auth)
get.description: Public-safe profile fields with optional Web cookie or native bearer authentication. An active authenticated owner may preview their own profile when profile_discoverable is false. Ownership is checked by stable profile_id from the verified principal, never by a claimed username/account_id/query value. Anonymous and other viewers receive identical 404 responses for hidden, inactive and missing profiles. Discoverability is not changed by preview. counts.saved_spots remains null for non-owners and an integer only for the owner. Owner responses are private/no-store and never written to shared profile caches. Display names are owner-approved; bio is untrusted plain text. No email, DOB or phone is exposed. Invalid native credentials return 401; conflicting Web/native transports return 422.

post.summary: Start a Quest participation
post.description: MOBILE-ONLY EXECUTION. Creates a Participation against the currently eligible immutable published QuestRevision for a Traveler who has not completed the stable Quest. Requires the attested Mobile Execution Credential. The backend first reconciles any existing ACTIVE Participation for this Traveler + stable Quest. If an older ACTIVE Participation is still valid, start fails with QUEST_ALREADY_ACTIVE. If any Participation for the stable Quest is already COMPLETED, start fails permanently with QUEST_ALREADY_COMPLETED; publishing a successor QuestRevision does not reopen earning. An EXPIRED historical Participation does not block a later eligible attempt on the current revision. Start is also rejected outside the current revision schedule or while the stable Quest is suspended. Same Idempotency-Key replay returns the stored original result; a new key never bypasses stable-Quest semantic uniqueness. A revoked RewardGrant does not reopen the stable Quest because QuestCompletion remains immutable in V1. A Traveler may concurrently hold active Participations for other stable Quests; V1 has no global single-active-Quest limit. On creation the Participation snapshots expires_at from the selected QuestRevision.ends_at; this effective deadline may later be extended by emergency suspension resume without changing the revision. R18: under stable Quest lock, reconcile existing participation first; a first-time Traveler admission requires remaining capacity. Atomically persist admission plus Participation. Quota full returns 409 with meta.code=QUEST_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED. Retry or previously admitted Traveler never consumes another slot; existing active/completed rules remain. Expired retry uses existing admission if otherwise eligible. No release after completion/expiry/revoke, no reset on successor revision. New Quest ID has independent quota and completion eligibility. Runtime Android memerlukan package, digest sertifikat, dan service account Play Integrity. iOS ditolak sampai adapter App Attest tersedia. Tidak ada fallback tanpa attestation. Hidden admission baru harus aktif/non-suspended dan berada dalam radius revision current; missing/outside location menghasilkan404 NOT_FOUND. Re-entry expired memerlukan radius lagi; owner dapat membaca Participation di luar radius. Koordinat tidak disimpan. Start pertama participation_mode=group memerlukan membership aktif dalam kelompok yang pengelolanya aktif. Admission yang sudah sah tetap dapat dilanjutkan/retry sendiri setelah leave, disband atau pengelola unavailable; aturan completion, expiry dan reward pribadi existing tetap berlaku. CONFLICT (409) juga mencakup admission pertama tanpa kelompok yang eligible.

Request selects activity_id; the server verifies that it belongs to the immutable QuestRevision and is not already verified. Before enforcing the one-unresolved-flow guard, an unresolved ProofSession whose execution_epoch is stale is reconciled deterministically: ACTIVE becomes expired; SUBMITTED-without-result receives a terminal expired ProofAttempt without verification/reward and remains SUBMITTED only as resolved transport history. Same-epoch SUBMITTED-without-result is reconciled using its immutable cutoff. Creation is rejected when the effective remaining Participation window (participation.expires_at; null means unbounded) is shorter than resolved minimum_required_session_seconds. The presented Mobile Execution Credential must also remain valid through the calculated ProofSession expires_at; otherwise no ProofSession/evidence state is created and the server returns EXECUTION_CREDENTIAL_TTL_INSUFFICIENT so the client can obtain a fresh credential and retry. Execution is rejected while the stable Quest execution_status is suspended. Current rule: activity_id must identify an available GPS activity on this Participation revision. Reject non-GPS/locked with 409 before collecting evidence. Accepted proof completes only that activity; all GPS/question activities must complete before grant.

nationality_country_code.description: ISO alpha-2; empty for a legacy profile awaiting completion.

nationality.description: Canonical English country name derived by the backend.

joined_year.description: coarse year only â€” NOT a full date (no DOB-style precision)

bio.description: Short public author/traveler bio. counts.description: Public profile aggregates for the profile/author stat strip. `itineraries`, `regions`, `published_stories` are public and count only public/published sets (published_stories = the author's published content, OQ-15; no draft leak). `saved_spots` is OWNER-ONLY â€” see its note. saved_spots.description: OWNER-ONLY. Saved spots are an owner relation (GET /apps/v1/me/saved-spots, PRD-0003). Projected SERVER-SIDE, defaulting to null; populated with the integer ONLY when the authenticated requester IS this profile's owner â€” resolved by matching the principal's stable account/profile id to the profile that owns {username}, NOT by string-comparing the token username to the URL {username} (usernames are mutable, C19.2). null for every other (incl. anonymous) viewer â€” another user's save list is not public. The owner/authed variant MUST NOT share a cache key with the public variant (C19.3). PRD-0011 OQ-19.

display_name.description: Full public display name composed from first and last name, approved by the owner on 2026-10-19. Null when absent.

ReferenceRatingView.description: Labeled-provisional AI reference on a read (PRD-0013 Arm B, ADR-0035). NEVER a PRD-0008 human-star rating (C6.2): the naming is 'reference'/'provisional', `origin` is always `ai`, `label` is the provisional i18n key, and `suppressed` is true when the signal is too thin to show a figure (score/confidence null when suppressed). It NEVER carries the basis/source URLs (those stay on the row â€” security-review). Only present for approved entities with a stored reference. Mirrors PRD-0013 ReferenceRatingView.

label.description: i18n key for the 'AI reference Â· provisional' affordance (OQ-4/OQ-11).

suppressed.description: true when the basis is too thin to show a figure (OQ-3).

cover_hero_image.description: Immersive hero/cover image resolved from cover_hero_image_id -> media_asset (PRD-0004 catalog-hero-read; migration 0034); null when unset. Distinct from the `media` gallery. Returned by BOTH the list and detail reads so spot cards render a cover, not just the detail page.

why_snippet.description: Short PLAIN-TEXT lead for the SpotCard description on grids (distinct from the detail-only SANITIZED HTML why_it_matters â€” must be HTML-escaped on render, never a dangerouslySetInnerHTML sink). null when unset. PRD-0011 OQ-20.

typical_duration_min.description: Typical visit duration in minutes for the SpotCard meta ("~2 hrs"). Promotes the field the detail already exposes (SpotDetail.typical_duration_min) onto the list projection so grids need no per-card detail fetch. PRD-0011 OQ-20.

category_slug.description: Kategori jenis tempat utama; wajib untuk approval, boleh kosong pada draft.

category_label.description: Current category vocabulary label resolved to the requested locale, with Indonesian/English fallback. Null when no label is available.

cover_hero_image.description: Cover yang diselesaikan melalui Media; null bila tidak tersedia.

nearby.description: Approved, unmerged Spots within a spherical radius of 5000 meters from this Spot, including other Locations and excluding self. Missing/invalid center coordinates yield an empty list; missing/invalid candidate coordinates are excluded. Maximum 15, ordered by available AI reference rating descending, then name and ID. Suppressed or absent references follow visible ratings.

available_locales.description: Locale yang memiliki cerita atau catatan kunjungan.

reference_rating.description: Rating referensi AI provisional yang eligible; null bila tidak tersedia.

story.description: Cerita tempat dalam HTML tersanitasi, sesuai locale/fallback. Cuplikan card diturunkan dari story.

oneOf.description: WGS84 GeoJSON geometry; closed rings, positions ordered longitude/latitude.

SpotDetail.description: Detail public Spot approved dengan proyeksi yang sama untuk id maupun slug. Source dan provenance kurator tidak diekspos.

arrive_time.description: Set ("HH:MM"), clear (null), or leave unchanged (omit) â€” PRD-0011 OQ-23.

travel_note.description: Set, clear (null), or leave unchanged (omit) â€” PRD-0011 OQ-23.

position.description: On POST (add a stop) this value is ADVISORY and ignored: the server APPENDS the new stop to the end of its day (next free position), so add-to-trip never conflicts on (day, position). travel_note.description: Optional MANUAL free-text travel note to the next stop â€” not routing (PRD-0011 OQ-23).

can_edit_registration.description: True hanya untuk Organizer pada Trip public active dengan rentang valid yang belum pertama dibuka menurut waktu server. Zona/visibility tetap immutable; writer memeriksa ulang di transaksi.

quest_id.description: Stable Quest identity. V1 completion is non-repeatable per Traveler + stable Quest; quest_revision_id remains the immutable rules/audit binding. The same Traveler may have other active Participations for different stable Quest IDs concurrently.

quest_revision_id.description: Immutable QuestRevision bound at Participation start. It defines the exact rules executed and remains visible for audit/history, but successor revisions do not reopen completion after the stable Quest is completed.

status.description: active/completed/expired. An incomplete participation becomes expired when its effective expires_at is passed while Quest execution is available; emergency suspension protects only non-terminal Participation eligible at suspension start (null deadline or expires_at > last_suspended_at). Earlier/equal deadlines cannot be revived by lazy status.

completed_at.description: Actual server completion timestamp; non-null only when status=completed.

quest_slug.description: Stable public Quest slug. The participation remains bound to quest_revision_id even when this slug now resolves public discovery to a successor revision.

quest_title.description: Traveler-facing title localized from the immutable QuestRevision bound to this Participation using the request locale; never read from the current successor revision.

expires_at.description: Authoritative execution deadline for this Participation. Initialized from the bound QuestRevision.ends_at at Start; null means unbounded. Emergency resume may extend this value without mutating the immutable QuestRevision.

expired_at.description: Actual server timestamp when Participation transitioned to expired; null unless status=expired.

participation_mode.description: Mode Quest dari revision participation yang terikat, termasuk ketika anggota grup melanjutkan solo. Respons lama dapat menghilangkan field ini.

QuestParticipation.description: Owner progress bound to immutable revision. All activities complete => one stable-Quest completion and one grant. completed count <= total. Read reconciles deadline/suspension. No embedded share; use explicit share endpoints.

QuestExecutionStatus.description: Operational safety control separate from immutable QuestRevision authoring state.

ActivityProgress.description: Derived lock state: free makes every unfinished activity available; sequential unlocks only the first unfinished ordinal. completed_at non-null only for completed. Wrong answers do not change progress.

instructions.description: Narasi HTML tersanitasi dengan subset p/br, strong/em, ul/ol/li dan a (http/https/mailto). Field dan bentuk locale/string tetap; input lama teks biasa tetap diterima, newline dipertahankan. Server menyaring input pada write dan legacy read; markup tanpa teks ditolak pada write. Consumer menampilkan rich text, metadata SEO menurunkan teks biasa. Judul, jawaban dan pilihan tetap plain text.

ActivityContent.description: Owner available/completed activity. GPS: answer_type=null, options empty, spot_id UUID, explanation null. Question: spot_id null; multiple_choice has >=2 options, text has none. Explanation null until correct. Never exposes correct_option_id or accepted_answers.

spot_id.description: Referensi Spot katalog publik untuk aktivitas gps pada detail discovery/reveal, diambil dari revision yang diproyeksikan. Null untuk question atau Spot yang tidak approved/telah digabung. Consumer membaca foto/detail melalui endpoint Spot existing dengan gate publiknya sendiri. Bukan anchor proof, tidak memuat koordinat/radius/bukti. Field opsional karena summary pada owner ActivityContent tetap memakai spot_id pada level atas.

ActivitySummary.description: Localized title. Discovery/reveal may expose a nullable public Spot reference for GPS visits. Does not expose options, answer key, explanation or frozen proof anchors. Owner activity summaries may omit spot_id; ActivityContent.spot_id remains the revision-bound target.

challenge.description: Opaque server-generated single-use challenge material to bind the provider attestation request.

integrity_token.description: Opaque Google Play Integrity response token bound to the server challenge. Local-only exception: with APP_ENV=local and QUEST_ANDROID_LOCAL_EXECUTION=true, the development Android app may send floopel-local: followed by unpadded base64url SHA-256 of the challenge. This is not device attestation; production always requires a Google token. Identity, one-use challenge, expiry and gameplay validation remain mandatory.

key_id.description: ID kunci App Attest, base64 standar kanonis dari hash SHA-256 public key. Key terdaftar terikat owner dan environment.

attestation_object.description: Objek CBOR App Attest berencoding base64 standar. ClientDataHash adalah SHA-256 dari UTF-8 string challenge server; jangan decode challenge base64 terlebih dahulu. Server memeriksa App ID, environment, kategori dan versi. Production hanya App Store; development hanya development build. Assertion wajib memakai key terdaftar dan counter meningkat.

key_id.description: ID kunci App Attest, base64 standar kanonis dari hash SHA-256 public key. Key terdaftar terikat owner dan environment.

assertion.description: Objek CBOR App Attest berencoding base64 standar. ClientDataHash adalah SHA-256 dari UTF-8 string challenge server; jangan decode challenge base64 terlebih dahulu. Server memeriksa App ID, environment, kategori dan versi. Production hanya App Store; development hanya development build. Assertion wajib memakai key terdaftar dan counter meningkat.

MobileExecutionAttestationRequest.description: Android uses Play Integrity. iOS uses first-time App Attest key attestation or a subsequent assertion. Provider payloads are verified by infrastructure adapters and are not gamification business state.

status.description: Closed transport/session lifecycle. Legal transitions are activeâ†’submitted on first submit and activeâ†’expired on TTL/schedule/stale-epoch invalidation before submit. Verification outcome does not mutate submitted to another transport status; submitted becomes resolved when its terminal ProofAttempt exists. A stale-epoch submitted-without-result session receives a terminal expired ProofAttempt while remaining submitted as transport history.

expires_at.description: Server-authoritative 5-minute v1 session TTL, clamped to the earlier of started_at+5m and the owning Participation.expires_at when non-null.

observation_count.description: Count of accepted unique observation_id values only.

activity_id.description: GPS activity on the immutable Participation revision.

execution_epoch.description: Snapshot of the stable Quest execution epoch. Session is invalid when it no longer matches the current Quest epoch.

ProofSession.description: Server-bound transport/session lifecycle for collecting GEO observations. It does not duplicate verification outcome; ProofAttempt is the sole verification-result source of truth. V1 has no explicit cancel endpoint; abandoned sessions recover via the short TTL.

captured_at.description: Untrusted client time; server received_at is authoritative for dwell/temporal checks.

observation_id.description: Client-generated semantic observation identity. Unique within a ProofSession; retry/replay of the same observation_id must not increase accepted observation_count.

AnswerQuestionRequest.description: Answer type must match bound immutable activity revision; mismatch 422. No client score/XP/correctness. Text normalized with trim + Unicode case folding on server and accepted variants, exact equality afterward. Internal whitespace, accents and punctuation remain significant. Blank text rejected. Wrong nonblank answer is incorrect, retry without penalty. Answer keys never returned.

AnswerQuestionResult.description: incorrect is HTTP 200, explanation=null; retry allowed without XP penalty. Correct/already_completed exposes explanation. Completion non-null only when authoritative completion exists. Retries never mint additional grant.

badge.description: Resolved Badge projection when reward_grant.badge_id is non-null. reward_grant.badge_effect determines newly granted vs already owned.

xp_amount.description: Immutable published reward amount, copied once at completion. Reversal uses append-only ledger, never changes this amount.

badge_id.description: Immutable intended Badge copied from resolved reward. badge_effect records whether ownership was newly granted or already existed.

badge_effect.description: Immutable completion-time UX effect. none when resolved badge_id is null; granted when no active support existed before this reward; already_owned when the Traveler already owned the Badge. Every non-null badge_id still creates one RewardGrant-linked BadgeGrant support row, so revoking another grant cannot incorrectly remove valid ownership.

url.description: Public-safe rendered badge image/derivative. Badge identity must never depend on this URL.

completion.description: Non-null only when this verified checkpoint causes or resolves to the Quest's authoritative completion.

ProofSubmitResultData.description: Synchronous authoritative submit result. Level is intentionally not snapshotted here; clients refresh /gamification/me/progress for current XP/Level after completion.

method.description: V1 only: outcome from exactly one server-timed GEO ProofSession.

status.description: Terminal v1 verification outcome. Synchronous submit does not persist a pending state.

reason_code.description: Controlled client-safe terminal reason. Stable across idempotent retry; never contains raw risk signals, evidence references, provider payloads, or anti-fraud thresholds.

proof_session_id.description: Required in v1; exactly one durable ProofAttempt per ProofSession.

xp_total.description: Authoritative balance derived from XP ledger; may decrease after reward revocation, which can also lower derived Level.

badges.description: Set-like Traveler-facing Badge ownership in v1. Multiple active RewardGrant-linked BadgeGrant support rows may back the same single visible Badge; ownership exists while at least one support remains active.

active_participations.description: All caller-owned active exploration Quest Participations; promotion excluded from Passport. Independent promotion Quest state needs its own non-Passport projection.

recent_completions.description: Most recent caller-owned exploration Quest completions; excludes promotion. Bounded history/re-share projection, not leaderboard.

GamificationProgress.description: Exploration-only Passport foundation. Promotion progress/completions/rewards must not enter this projection. Purpose-aware implementation is required before promotion launch.

policy_revision.description: Level-policy revision used to derive this projection.

LevelSummary.description: Derived from current authoritative XP ledger balance. Level is not independently mutable.

quest_id.description: Stable Quest identity. A Traveler has at most one V1 completion for this stable Quest across all revisions.

quest_revision_id.description: Immutable QuestRevision actually completed. Historical/audit binding only; V1 earning uniqueness is Traveler + stable Quest.

quest_title.description: Traveler-facing title from the immutable QuestRevision that this completion actually completed.

xp_awarded.description: Original immutable grant amount, before any later reversal.

badge.description: Resolved/intended Badge projection when badge_id was non-null, regardless of whether ownership was newly granted or already owned.

share_available.description: True only while RewardGrant remains granted.

badge_effect.description: Badge ownership effect of this RewardGrant.

quota.description: null when unlimited. Visible only with authorized Quest projection; Hidden access rules unchanged.

group_size_limit.description: Per kelompok termasuk pembuat; null untuk personal, wajib bernilai untuk group. Bukan participant_limit lifetime.

is_taken.description: Hanya proyeksi katalog akun: profil terautentikasi pernah mendapat admission pada stable Quest ini. Bukan status selesai atau bukti reward; dihilangkan pada katalog publik.

ItineraryOperationKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ItineraryOperationKey.description: One stable UUIDv7 per logical operation under ADR-0061. Reuse the key for an identical retry; an intentional new action uses a new key. Replay returns the same result identity under current authorization and does not execute a second mutation. Changed operation, concrete target or input with the same actor/key returns 409. ADR-0062 limits retry to 24 hours from the embedded timestamp, validated against server time before any write/replay. Expired, unsupported-version and excessive-future keys return 422 even if no receipt exists. Never automatically replace an expired uncertain operation with a fresh key. Reject when the embedded timestamp is more than five minutes ahead of server time or more than 24 hours old. Exactly five minutes ahead and exactly 24 hours old remain within the respective limits. The client explains excessive clock skew and asks the user to synchronize the device clock.
